# Goal
Execute tsukuroi round 13 only. Single claim C1 depth: correct round-12 false universal about unit read-only root paths, with a source-grounded superseding MD/JSON correction, preserve historical evidence and show a narrow check fails on old bytes and passes on corrected active content. Depth and adjacency tied lowest at 8. L1 holds canonical planner seat. Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/AGENTS.md, corpus/QUALITY.md and corpus/lessons/round-12-verifier-spotcheck.md before work.
# Contract
You are a leaf. No delegation, no background jobs, no commits. Do not run tests/build/lint/formatters or repeat reported failures. Read-only investigation except your explicit disjoint write set. Each seat writes only its absolute report /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tsukuroi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-13/correction/<Name>.md plus explicitly assigned implementation paths. All source/host/sibling surfaces read-only; never credentials, raw journal bodies, repairs or privileged probes. Reports concise (prefer <100 lines) with observed pointers, not admission authority. No SHONEN [x]. Corpus corrections new entries plus explicit supersession notices; LOG append belongs L1. Do not edit any other seat files, fleet files or source registry unless specifically assigned.
Tooling authorization: you and every seat may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate, record tool/version/channel/reason in the report). No install needed is an acceptable result.
